BrochureContent.Content:
This superb 2,500 sq ft dormer bungalow offers spacious and modern family living in a highly sought-after location along Millview Road. The home features gas-fired central heating and boasts five double bedrooms, including one conveniently located on the ground floor. The master bedroom is a true retreat, complete with its own en-suite and a generous walk-in wardrobe, while three additional bedrooms also benefit from en-suite bathrooms. A large family bathroom provides both luxury and comfort with its jacuzzi bath and separate shower. The property includes two large reception rooms, ideal for entertaining or relaxing and features a fully fitted modern kitchen with all contemporary appliances, a free-standing range, a feature island with an integrated chopping board, and a utility room off the kitchen. This stunning family home has newly fitted carpets upstairs and repainted throughout, the home feels bright, clean, and move-in ready.

Set on a circa 0.2-acre fully walled site, the property offers excellent privacy and a private driveway with parking for up to three cars. Its prime position ensures exceptional convenience—within walking distance of a primary school, local shops, bus routes, the estuary, beautiful coastal walks and nearby beaches. The home is just a short distance from Malahide Railway Station, offering both commuter rail and DART services, making travel into Dublin city centre fast and effortless. It is also only a 20-minute walk to Malahide village with its wide selection of cafés, boutiques, and amenities, and is ideally located close to Dublin Airport, the Malahide Road, and the M50. This is a fantastic opportunity to acquire a beautifully presented family home in a prestigious, well-connected, and coastal neighbourhood.
